extracted.name: Grilled Sliced Zucchini
extracted.description: This summer recipe for grilled sliced zucchini begins by coating the squash in Italian dressing, then cooking it over a hot grate until lightly charred.
instruction_lines: Preheat an outdoor grill and lightly oil the grate.
Cut zucchini into ¼-inch slices; transfer to a bowl and toss with Italian dressing until evenly coated.
Cook on the preheated grill until grill marks appear and zucchini is slightly limp, 4 to 5 minutes.
